items.summary: The newly formed People Against SIR alliance (formed Oct 14, students/farmers/Dalits/Adivasis/minorities) has called nationwide protest marches on Friday, Oct 23 under the slogan 'Har haath mei Tiranga, Har gali mei Jantar Mantar' — citizens urged to set up local 'Jantar Mantars' in every street. Noted economist Parakala Prabhakar (husband of Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, and a speaker at CJP's Oct-8 Bengaluru protest) is set to share the stage with CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke and actor-activist Prakash Raj, alongside Prashant Bhushan, Rakesh Tikait, AISA president Neha Bora and Tushar Gandhi. The alliance demands the scrapping of SIR and the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar — and separately wants Parliament to move impeachment against the CEC over the alleged exclusion of ~13.4 crore voters. INDIA bloc parties were invited; their participation is unconfirmed. The call comes as CJP and the INDIA bloc paused street protests around Diwali.
items.title: People Against SIR alliance calls nationwide Oct-23 marches; Parakala Prabhakar to share stage with Dipke

items.summary: WION reports a fresh detail of today's 2 PM IST SEM Mandir Marg release order: released CJP co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have undertaken not to call protests at Jantar Mantar until it remains de-notified as a designated protest site. The undertaking was part of the release proceedings in which the SEM accepted their sureties (after rejecting defective ones), declined Delhi Police's request for 3 more days of judicial custody, and ended their 7-day detention over the Oct-13 Tiranga protest/peace-bond breach. No corroborating second outlet yet — carried only by WION's verified IG post.
items.title: Released Das, Ranka undertake not to call protests at Jantar Mantar while it stays de-notified
